notes:
Tasks
- New Tasks tab beside the Agenda (and a Tasks button on the left bar). Add tasks with due dates, times and notes; get a notification when they're due.
- Make a task from any email: right-click > Add as task, the Add as task button in the reader, or drag it onto the Tasks panel. The task links back to the email.
- Follow-up reminders and snoozed mail show up among your tasks.
- Tasks sync with Google Tasks and Microsoft To Do. Existing Gmail and Outlook accounts need to reconnect once (the Tasks panel shows a Reconnect button). Tasks kept on this computer sync through Sync settings.

Look and layout
- A thin bar on the left switches between Mail, Calendar and Tasks; Settings moved to its bottom corner.
- The right panel can be resized by dragging its left edge.
- Stacks cards can have colors (Settings > Categories > Colors). Priority is orange, Starred yellow and Primary blue by default.
- The Read card is dimmed so finished mail recedes.
- A blue calendar button in the Agenda opens the full calendar.
